meaning: Implemented means source exists, not released or device-verified.

senior_first_features.meaning: Per-feature execution status for docs/specs/senior-first/feature-catalog.json. Catalog IDs not listed here have not been started. implemented_unverified means source and automated widget tests exist (flutter analyze strict + flutter test pass locally); no native device, VoiceOver/TalkBack or user-comprehension evidence exists yet.

GM-001.scope: Gentle matching screen is board-first with no settings in the first view; the home screen was not changed and fresh-install/upgrade/device journeys are untested.

GM-002.scope: Gentle matching screen only: Done for now is fixed in a bottom bar, Start again confirms only with progress and Cancel keeps the board, finishing offers Play again beside Done. Photo, together and legacy-library screens not audited.

GM-003.scope: Tile count and visible-picture choice persist as a versioned, field-by-field-safe record; reset touches comfort choices only. Text size/motion preferences and other screens are not covered.

GM-004.scope: Matching screen only: the unfinished board (picture ids and tile positions, no score/time/path) saves after each tap and clears on finish or a confirmed restart; reopening offers Carry on or Start fresh, never resumes silently; missing pictures, corrupt or other-version records start fresh without touching photos or settings. Starter and family boards are kept apart. Real process-kill, backgrounding and device checks pending; lifecycle-resume of a backgrounded (not killed) page relies on Flutter keeping page state.

GM-005.scope: How-this-works help opens on request from the matching screen without resetting play. Error-state review and screen-reader reading-order checks pending.

GM-012.scope: Matching screen reflows at 200% text on 390x844 and 320x568: the board comes first (instruction moves below it above 150% text), exit buttons stack, dialogs scroll. Other screens and device checks pending.

GM-013.scope: Tiles are at least 64 and as large as the space allows (shared gmBoardColumns); controls keep the 48/56 floor. Tremor/repeated-tap testing pending.

GM-016.scope: Matching screen verified in widget tests on small phone, phone, landscape phone and iPad portrait sizes. Real iPad/device layout review pending.

GM-018.scope: Pre-existing explicit-picker import and storage limits are unchanged. New journey tests cover choose, a failed or out-of-space import leaving the collection intact with a safe message, a damaged optional sidecar not affecting photos, and restart, using a fake picker and real storage. HEIC, cloud-only originals, partial access, Android recovery and real low-storage device checks remain pending.

GM-019.scope: Optional caption (60) and screen-reader description (280) per family photo in a versioned additive sidecar (annotations.json) keyed by existing photo ids; text is normalized (control/direction characters removed, length capped) and treated as inert data; an unreadable sidecar is kept aside and never invalidates photos; deleting a copy removes its entry. Captions show in Look together only when 'Show captions' is on; hidden game tiles never expose captions or descriptions. Not covered: screen-reader device checks, in-game caption display (intentionally none).

GM-020.scope: Family photos only: Favorite sorts a photo first; Hide excludes it from the game and Look together without deleting the copy, is shown with the word 'Hidden', persists and is undone by turning the switch off (no countdown); Remove is a separate confirmed action. Fewer than two visible photos disables the game with an explanation and never silently unhides. Included packs, replay and interest filters are not covered.

GM-028.scope: Source-level audit and CI guard only: startup initializes no backend, local photo features contain no network code, collection flags are disabled in both manifests, only the photo-picker permission is declared, and the legacy remote downloader has no static route from any screen. Not established: merged Android manifest, FirebaseInitProvider behavior, runtime traffic on a clean install, iOS privacy manifest/App Privacy answers. The privacy_and_sdk_audit gate remains pending.
